اقتضبا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَضَبَا (iqtaḍabā) /iq.ta.dˤa.baː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# اُقْتُضِبَا (uqtuḍibā) /uq.tu.dˤi.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# اِقْتَضِبَا (iqtaḍibā) /iq.ta.dˤi.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
